title: Evaluation of SARS-CoV-2 vaccination in pregnant and breastfeeding women.
ehr_evidence: Data were collected via an anonymous online questionnaire created via Google Forms.
summary: Evaluation of the safety experience of SARS-CoV-2 vaccination in pregnant and breastfeeding women in Slovakia and the Czech Republic.
key_findings: Safety profile of SARS-CoV-2 vaccines in pregnant and breastfeeding women was similar to the general population.
Breastfeeding women experienced higher rates of adverse events (AEs) than pregnant women.
No pattern of serious adverse events (SAEs) emerged.
population: 2192 pregnant or breastfeeding women from Slovakia and Czech Republic
limitations: Data recorded before the Omicron variant
data_availability_statement: Supplementary material associated with this article can be found, in the online version, at doi: 10.1016/j.ijregi.2023.06.002.
